wardrobe.description: Soft bedtime pajamas suitable for sleeping, consistent across the whole book; simple, cozy, and not costume-like.
Simple soft collar or tiny harness carrying a small round lantern at the chest/neck area; the lantern is the main magical-looking accessory and changes brightness as the story requires.

mustShow: bed as a small safe island in a softly dark bedroom
child in consistent bedtime pajamas
fox companion with small glowing neck lantern
teddy bear visible across a dim floor path
ordinary bedroom objects subtly suggesting a pretend night-sea adventure
coverContract.worldType: cozy modern bedroom with gentle bedtime fantasy: ordinary room objects briefly imagined as a tiny night-sea adventure, always resolving into safe, familiar shapes

forbiddenGlobalElements: real ocean water or flooding in the bedroom
boats that are actual vehicles rather than imagination
sharp weapons or pirate combat props
horror lighting, jump scares, or threatening faces in shadows
gore, injury, tears of panic, or medical equipment
daylight, windows showing morning sun, or outdoor scenes
new pets or companions beyond the fox companion

anchors.description: Low child-sized bed with blanket and pillow, always in the same corner of the room.
Small warm bedside lamp on a simple nightstand beside the bed.
Closed bedroom door across the floor from the bed; the teddy lands near this door.
Clear stretch of bedroom floor between the bed and the door, visually treated as the 'night-sea' until the lantern reveals it is shallow darkness.
Soft rug partly visible under fallen objects once the dim lantern reveals the bottom of the darkness.

locations.description: A small, safe bedroom seen at bedtime. The room becomes visually imaginative after the light goes out: darkness pools across the floor like a quiet sea, while the bed reads as a little island. All fantasy elements remain soft, symbolic, and clearly made from real bedroom shadows and objects.
locations.lighting: Warm bedside lamp at first, then very low darkness with a small fox lantern that changes from faint to too-bright to carefully dimmed. Shadows are soft-edged, never horror-like.
locations.name: Child's bedroom at night
locations.topology: One continuous bedroom. The bed zone connects directly to the bedside floor threshold, which leads along the floor path toward the door area. The return path follows the same route back to the bed.
